sources.snippet: Welcome to Qwen! ¶ Qwen is the large language model and large multimodal model series of the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group. Both language models and multimodal models are pretrained on large-scale multilingual and multimodal data and post-trained on quality data for aligning to human preferences. Qwen is capable of natural language understanding, text generation, vision understanding, audio ...
